subject: Spend range sanity check — procurement thresholds & next steps
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@novusai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.g@novusai.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: pricing/volume discussion (today)

Thanks for taking the time this morning. Quick written recap so we have the same baseline and can move to procurement.

Notes from our call:
- Workload: conversational search + knowledge-grounded chat for a marketplace. Average prompt+response ~1.1k tokens.
- Volume estimate (monthly): low: 200M tokens | mid: 450M tokens | high: 900M tokens. (See attached novus-monthly-volume-estimates.xlsx)
- Current target unit economics: Novus is looking to land at or below $0.75 / 1M tokens if we go dedicated/reserved. Hosted (on-demand) target is less important for them now.
- Budget band: core budget they can commit to in the near term is $12k - $55k / month depending on final unit price and runway.
- Procurement: finance requires a PO for any recurring spend > $25k / month or a quarterly PO >= $50k. Annual SOWs need legal review.

Action items we asked from Redwood:
1) Ballpark monthly cost ranges for the three volume tiers and both Hosted vs Dedicated options (include per-1M token price used for calc).
2) Confirmation whether Redwood can accept quarterly PO (instead of monthly) with an invoice cadence to match.
3) Any upfront minimums or commitment terms that affect unit price.

We'd like a short written estimate by early next week; Samir and Elena are available Tue/Wed for a follow-up.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform
NovusAI

-- Attachment: novus-monthly-volume-estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing/volume discussion (today)

Hi Samir / Elena — thanks for the clear notes and the volume worksheet. Quick confirmation and a few clarifying Qs so our estimate is precise: 

1) When you list "target $0.75 / 1M tokens (dedicated)", is that the blended target including KV caching and prefix cache benefits, or is that the raw decode cost? If blended, can you flag which scenario (best-case caching) corresponds to the low/mid/high volumes?
2) Procurement: do you need Redwood to be on your PO for each month, or is a quarterly PO sufficient for your finance team provided invoices are issued monthly? You mentioned >$25k/month triggers a PO; is the $25k threshold firm?
3) Timeline: if we land a committed reserved plan, what internal approvals would you need and how long does Legal typically take on SOWs? (Elena, can you advise?)

Internal note to Aditya / Marissa: cc'd above — once Samir confirms the caching assumption we can ship a two-line hosted vs dedicated band and one optional quarterly-PO-friendly contract template. Aditya, Marissa — please prepare a banded estimate (low/mid/high) for both hosted and 12-mo reserved with two commitment levels (standard/discounted) and call out the unit $/1M used in each cell. I will share the draft with Novus.

Proposed next steps:
- I (So) will follow up with a written estimate by Mon 15 Mar EOD PT.
- Samir/Elena: pick a 30-min slot Tue/Wed next week if you want to walk numbers.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: draft bands for Novus (do not forward)

Team — draft ballpark bands below. This is internal; I'll attach the formal PDF once we agree on wording. Numbers assume 1.1k avg tokens/session and progressive caching at scale (we show both raw and effective rates).

Hosted (no commitment):
- Low (200M tokens): $2.00 / 1M => monthly ~$400 (this is illustrative; hosted has per-request latency premium).
- Mid (450M): $2.00 / 1M => monthly ~$900
- High (900M): $1.80 / 1M (volume discount kicks in) => monthly ~$1,620

Dedicated / 12-mo reserved (standard):
- Low: effective $1.10 / 1M => monthly ~$220
- Mid: effective $0.85 / 1M => monthly ~$383
- High: effective $0.65 / 1M => monthly ~$585

Dedicated / 12-mo reserved (discounted, 20% off for quarterly PO >= $50k):
- Low: $0.88 / 1M => ~$176 / month
- Mid: $0.68 / 1M => ~$306 / month
- High: $0.52 / 1M => ~$468 / month

Notes:
- The "effective" numbers include expected KV/prefix cache savings based on Redwood's serving runtime; raw decode-only cost would be ~30-40% higher at scale.
- Our commercial prefers a quarterly PO cadence for customers with >$50k quarterly spend; we can accept monthly billing for lower bands.
- Standard minimum commitment for reserved capacity is $25k/month equivalent for a 12-month term. We can make exceptions with legal approval but price moves accordingly.

Next: I'll convert these to a two-page estimate (redwood-pricing-bands-v2.pdf) and flag the specific cells that align with Novus's "target $0.75 / 1M" ask. If Soojin thinks we should push a 10% intro discount to help them cross the PO threshold this quarter, say so and I'll bake it in.

-Aditya
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: redwood-pricing-bands-v2.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Samir Patel <samir@novusai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.g@novusai.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spend range sanity check — procurement thresholds & next steps

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the internal draft, Aditya. Two quick items from our side after reviewing the bands: 

1) The discounted dedicated high-volume effective $0.52 / 1M looks attractive. To be honest, our internal target to make a quarterly PO practical is closer to $0.70 / 1M blended across our mid->high band. If you can get us to ~$0.70 / 1M with a quarterly PO of $50k (or $150k/quarter commit), we can fast-track approvals.
2) Procurement: finance confirmed they will accept a quarterly PO (one PO covering three months) provided each invoice matches the month and the vendor (Redwood) is on the PO. Legal will need a short SOW but can do a quick review in ~7 business days if terms are standard.

Next steps for us: please send a one-page formal estimate reflecting (a) a 12-mo reserved option at ~$0.70 / 1M blended with quarterly PO cadence, and (b) a hosted on-demand comparison for transparency. We can sign a quarterly PO for the first quarter to get started pending a full SOW.

Elena attached our signed NDA for completeness. Happy to take a 30-min call Tue 15 Mar 10:00am PT to finalize details.

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform | NovusAI
